stance_rationale: Replacement scenario classification is mostly correct, but the admission draft relies on unverified or internally inconsistent evidence: missing WT artifacts, pending Harvey/DSR, zero recorded costs despite net-cost claims, and unproven cash-overlay/AX-007 exception. This should not be finalized as ADMIT_CONDITIONAL until the official contract and verification package are regenerated.

scenario_rule_audit.rule_misapplication_evidence: Governor explicitly labels OVERRIDE_008 as STR_1631_SYN_06 -> STR_1715 100% replacement and states Sequential Admission TDC/family/Pareto rules are inapplicable; RF-G1/RF-G2 are not the main failure.

family_saturation_audit.new_strategy_family: Multi-sleeve claim: 4F Consensus + Q07 + M08 + Q25 plus claimed regime cash overlay
family_saturation_audit.baseline_family_overlap: STR_1631_SYN_06 is consensus/defense overlay; WT-P20260429_002 lacks weights.csv, alpha_package, risk_package, optimization_package, and stage artifacts needed to measure overlap consistently.

multi_objective_audit.single_axis_compensating: Point SR/CAGR/MDD/IR improve versus SYN_06, but Harvey/DSR are pending and official net-cost/cash-overlay evidence is inconsistent.

ax_008_triangulation.lockbox_alternative_validation: Insufficient: Forge retrofit PASS is present via registry/output, but Codex was pending in the draft and Q-Lead/Architect lifecycle is not an independent verification source. Missing stage artifacts block independent alpha/covariance/schedule checks.

critical_concerns.description: WT-P20260429_002 contains only governor_admission_draft.json; requested alpha_package/risk_package/optimization_package/challenge notes/weights.csv and both specified stage_artifact directories are absent, so the claimed 6-stage verification, alpha time-series, covariance PSD/condition, and schedule fidelity cannot be independently checked.

The draft repeatedly says 167bps annual cost drag is already reflected in ret_net, but 03_period_returns.csv has cost_ret=0 for all 267 months and ret_net equals ret_gross for all rows. A rough round-trip 15bps adjustment lowers SR from 1.595 to about 1.526, so dominance may survive, but the official admission evidence is not net-of-cost as claimed.

The draft uses regime cash overlay to justify AX-001/AX-005/AX-007, but the official contract has Average_Cash_Weight blank, cash_weight blank for every period, leverage=1 for every period, and holdings weights sum to 1 on all 267 dates. Cash may exist in another internal run, but the official bt_result does not prove it.

Replacement rules require direct SR/CAGR/MDD/Harvey/DSR comparison, yet STR_1715 Harvey 5-spec and DSR are pushed to POST_DEPLOY_003 T+14 while the baseline book_state also has Harvey pending. The draft admits on point estimates plus bootstrap instead of completed multi-testing defense.

The draft cites lockbox-released full-period results, OOS 2024-2026 SR 2.99, and recent 12M SR 4.42, but the requested alpha_scores.parquet and stage artifacts are absent and no Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined 3-way report is attached. This leaves the strongest recent-performance claim exposed to selection-after-release risk.

The draft frames STR_1715 as all-axis dominant, but it does not fully quantify worse CVaR99/Return-to-CVaR/tail exposure, book diversification forfeit, or frequency mismatch in turnover metrics. Replacement can still be viable, but the stated rationale is stronger than the verified evidence.

supporting_arguments: RF-G1/RF-G2 pass: the draft correctly treats this as replacement, not sequential admission, and does not apply TDC<0.30 as a rejection rule.
Hard concentration checks on official STR_1715 holdings pass: 267 rebalance dates, max 20 names, weights sum to 1, max weight 0.20, long-only.
Registry-level point estimates match the draft broadly: STR_1715 SR 1.595, CAGR about 41.91%, MDD about 35.56%, turnover about 557% annualized.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the true simulation applied costs and cash overlay before the Backtest Result Contract lost those fields, or whether the official registry metrics are actually gross/no-cash.
Whether STR_1715 can pass Harvey 5-spec and DSR after corrected cost/cash metadata and factor regressions.
Whether the WT-P20260429_002 artifacts were omitted from the workspace or never produced.
Whether lockbox-released full-period optimization contaminated the OOS claims without a sealed 3-way report.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that audit 10/10 PASS on STR_1715_WT016_Iter31_20260429_001 proves a production-grade, net-of-cost, cash-overlay, Harvey-valid replacement despite missing WT artifacts and official contract fields showing zero costs and no cash exposure.
rebuttal_required: Provide WT-P20260429_002 alpha/risk/optimization packages, challenge notes, weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, and covariance.parquet or correct the paths.
Regenerate bt_result so ret_gross, ret_net, cost_ret, cash_weight, leverage, and holdings all reconcile with the claimed 15bps cost model and 10/20/40 cash overlay.
Run and attach Harvey 5-spec Newey-West-12 plus DSR for both STR_1715 and STR_1631_SYN_06 before final governor admission.
Provide Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined 3-way reporting for the lockbox-released STR_1715 run.
Restate the verdict rationale with explicit tail-risk, turnover, and diversification trade-offs rather than all-axis dominance.
